transcript.t: The mascot of the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics was a panda called Bing Dwen Dwen. The word bing means ice, and the panda wore a clear shell of ice.

Pandas are friendly animals, and many people around the world love them. Soon after the Games began, the mascot became so popular that shops quickly sold out of Bing Dwen Dwen toys. People waited in long lines to buy one.
The mascot showed the Olympic ideas of friendship and pride.
